# Xbox
> Xbox account services for connecting to games, friends, achievements, and community across Xbox experiences.

Xbox provides account, profile, social, support, and gaming service resources for players using Xbox consoles, apps, and web experiences. This index highlights key account, support, community, and service pages relevant to understanding Xbox Live and Xbox account functionality.

## Account
- [Xbox Account Home](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/live): Overview of Xbox account benefits, sign-in, and connected gaming features.
- [Create an Xbox Account](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/live): Entry point for creating a free Xbox account and getting started.
- [Microsoft Account](https://account.microsoft.com/): Manage the Microsoft account used for Xbox identity, billing, and security.
- [Xbox Profile](https://account.xbox.com/en-us/Profile): View and manage gamertag, profile details, and public presence settings.
- [Xbox Privacy Settings](https://account.xbox.com/en-us/Settings): Configure privacy, online safety, and communication preferences for Xbox services.
- [Xbox Family Settings](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/family-settings-app): Manage family groups, screen time, and child account safety controls.

## Support
- [Xbox Support Home](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/): Central support portal for Xbox accounts, consoles, subscriptions, and troubleshooting.
- [Account and Profile Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/account-profile): Help articles for sign-in, profile management, and account settings.
- [Microsoft Account for Xbox Help](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/account-profile/manage-account): Guidance for managing the Microsoft account tied to Xbox.
- [Xbox Network Status](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-live-status): Live service status for Xbox network features and platform services.
- [Password and Security Help](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/account-profile/manage-account): Support for password resets, security info, and account recovery.
- [Billing and Subscriptions Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/subscriptions-billing): Help for purchases, billing issues, and recurring subscriptions.

## Gaming and Social
- [Xbox App](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/xbox-app-for-pc): Information about the Xbox app for PC and connected social features.
- [Xbox Cloud Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/play): Play supported Xbox games through cloud streaming on supported devices.
- [Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass): Subscription service for accessing a catalog of games across devices.
- [Achievements](https://account.xbox.com/en-us/Profile): Access Xbox profile activity, achievements, and gaming history.
- [Friends and Clubs Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/friends-social-activity): Help for friends lists, clubs, parties, and social activity.
- [Looking for Group Support](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/friends-social-activity): Guidance for multiplayer social features and player connections.

## Devices and Apps
- [Xbox Consoles](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/consoles): Overview of Xbox console hardware and platform options.
- [Xbox Series X](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/consoles/xbox-series-x): Product page for Xbox Series X console hardware.
- [Xbox Series S](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/consoles/xbox-series-s): Product page for Xbox Series S console hardware.
- [Xbox Mobile App](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/xbox-app-for-mobile): Mobile app for chat, captures, remote features, and account access.
- [Xbox Family Settings App](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/family-settings-app): Mobile app for parental controls and family account management.
- [PC Game Pass and PC App](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/apps/xbox-app-for-pc): PC gaming app and subscription entry point.

## Subscriptions and Purchases
- [Xbox Game Pass](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass): Subscription plans for console, PC, and cloud gaming access.
- [Redeem Code](https://redeem.microsoft.com/): Redeem Xbox gift cards, subscriptions, and digital content codes.
- [Order History](https://account.microsoft.com/billing/orders): Review Microsoft and Xbox purchase history and transaction details.
- [Services and Subscriptions](https://account.microsoft.com/services): Manage active Microsoft and Xbox subscriptions in one place.
- [Payment Options](https://account.microsoft.com/billing/payments): Manage saved payment methods for Microsoft and Xbox purchases.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/gift-cards): Learn about Xbox gift cards and digital balance usage.

## Safety and Family
- [Xbox Safety](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/community/for-everyone/responsible-gaming): Xbox responsible gaming and player safety resources.
- [Online Safety and Privacy](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/family-online-safety/online-safety): Support for privacy controls and safer online interactions.
- [Family Group Help](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/family-online-safety/child-accounts): Help for child accounts, guardians, and family group setup.
- [Content Restrictions](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/family-online-safety/online-safety): Guidance for age filters and content access controls.
- [Report a Player](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/friends-social-activity/player-behavior/how-to-report-a-player): Instructions for reporting abusive behavior or unsafe interactions.
- [Community Standards](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/legal/community-standards): Rules and expectations for behavior across Xbox services.

## Developers and Network Services
- [Xbox Developer](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/games/xbox/): Developer resources for building and publishing on Xbox platforms.
- [Microsoft Game Dev](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/games/): Broader Microsoft game development portal including Xbox-related tools.
- [Xbox Services for Developers](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/games/xbox/docs/gdk/): Documentation entry point for Xbox Game Development Kit resources.
- [Partner Center](https://partner.microsoft.com/): Business and publishing portal for Microsoft and Xbox partners.
- [Microsoft Learn for Gaming](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/): Technical documentation and learning resources for Microsoft gaming technologies.
- [Xbox Network Status](https://support.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-live-status): Operational status page relevant to Xbox online service availability.

## Legal and Policies
- [Xbox Terms of Use](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/servicesagreement): Microsoft services agreement governing Xbox account and service usage.
- [Microsoft Privacy Statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement): Privacy policy covering Xbox and Microsoft account data handling.
- [Xbox Community Standards](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/legal/community-standards): Behavioral standards and enforcement expectations for Xbox users.
- [Microsoft Services Agreement FAQ](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/servicesagreement/upcoming-updates): Information about updates to Microsoft service terms.
- [Xbox Accessibility](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/accessibility): Accessibility features and inclusive gaming resources across Xbox products.
- [Responsible Gaming](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/community/for-everyone/responsible-gaming): Resources promoting healthy play and safer gaming habits.
